text:
Mara K: Suggestion: run a 61week pilot for a compact 'Remediation Ledger' to track postmortem actions. Single record per incident with owner, due date, status, recurrence-tag, PM link, and IC-rotation note. Keep weekly 15-min pulse. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Jordan L: Sounds lightweight. Can we ensure low friction by auto-creating ledger items when a postmortem is marked 'closed'?

Samir: +1. Minimal ledger template below. Prefer GH issues for assignability and reminders, but accept a shared doc for quick start.

Samir: ```
Remediation Ledger entry:
- Incident: 
- PM link: 
- Owner: @
- Due: YYYY-MM-DD
- Severity: Sev1/Sev2/Sev3
- Status: open/in-progress/blocked/closed
- Recurrence-tag: none/recurring/suspected
- RCA (1-line): 
- Actions: [task1] [task2]
- IC-rotation: keep/rotate
- Check-ins: weekly dates
```

Khalid: 👍 GH issues please. I'll create labels: backlog/active/blocked/recurring-pattern and a small dashboard showing weekly counts and top recurring routes.

Rowan: For IC rotation, add a field in the ledger that recommends the next IC (same/team rotation/volunteer). Also create a monthly IC sign-up calendar in the handbook.

Elena: Proposed comms cadence:
- T+0: incident post + short triage in #eng-oncall
- T+1h: status update
- T+24h: summary + ledger link (owners/due dates/recurrence)
- T+72h: remediation progress update
- Weekly: pulse check until actions closed or reprioritized
Make the T+24h include a compact owners/due table for product/support visibility.

ops-bot: note: Remediation Ledger template added (https://go.redwood.example/remediation-ledger) :bell:

Mara K: Volunteers: Jordan can wire the repo + GH Action to auto-open issues and ping owners; Samir will own the ledger template and the weekly pulse checklist; Khalid will build the recurring-pattern dashboard; Rowan will maintain the IC calendar.

Jordan L: I'll draft the GH Action and a small cron that pings owners 48h before due.

Samir: I'll prepare the pulse checklist and a one-pager for the pilot runbook.

Khalid: I'll prototype the dashboard and labels this week.

Rowan: I'll add the calendar and rotation rules to the handbook.

Mara K: Proposed success criteria for the 6-week pilot: owners assigned within 48h of postmortem close, >=85% actions have due dates, weekly pulses held with at least one owner update. Start Monday?

Jordan L: Good with me.

Samir: Ready.

Khalid: :thumbsup:

Rowan: +1

Mara K: I'll post kickoff + the template tomorrow. Ping me if you want to join the pilot.
